# Tech Stack

## AS IS — Current state

### Runtime and language

- **Language**: PHP ^8.5 (`composer.json` `"php": "^8.5"`; images `dunglas/frankenphp:php8.5-bookworm` dev, `dunglas/frankenphp:1-php8.5-alpine` prod); TypeScript ^5.7 (locked 5.9.3, `tsconfig.json` strict) for the admin UI
- **Framework**: Laravel ^13.0 (locked v13.35.0); Inertia.js v2 (`inertiajs/inertia-laravel` v2.0.28, `@inertiajs/react` 2.3.27) + React ^19 (locked 19.2.7)

| Component | Version | Source |
|---|---|---|
| App server (prod) | Laravel Octane v2.21.0 on FrankenPHP | `docker/prod/8.4/Dockerfile`, `supervisord-coolify.conf` (`octane:start --server=frankenphp`) |
| App server (dev) | `frankenphp php-server` | `docker/supervisord/supervisord.conf` |
| Queues | Laravel Horizon v5.50.0 on Redis 7.4.0 (`phpredis`) | `config/horizon.php`, `docker-compose.yml` |
| Database | PostgreSQL 18 (`pgvector/pgvector:pg18`) | `docker-compose.yml`, `database/schema/pgsql-schema.sql` |
| APM | Laravel Pulse v1.8.1 | `config/pulse.php`, `pulse:check` program |
| Frontend build | Vite 5.4.11, `laravel-vite-plugin` 1.0.6, `@vitejs/plugin-react` 4.7.0 | `vite.config.js`, entry `resources/js/app.tsx` |
| CSS / UI | Tailwind CSS 4.3.2, shadcn/ui style `new-york`, `radix-ui` 1.6.2, `lucide-react`, `recharts` 3.10.0 | `components.json`, `resources/js/components/ui/` |
| Node | 22 | prod/dev Dockerfiles |
| Package managers | Composer 2 (`composer.lock`), npm (`package-lock.json`, `npm ci` in `Dockerfile.coolify`) | |
| Timezone | `America/Sao_Paulo` | `Dockerfile.coolify`; `Processo` accessors convert `created_at`/`updated_at` |
| Host PHP | not installed; run PHP via `./php` wrapper → `docker compose exec -u composer php php` | `php` script, `ralph.sh` |

### Tests

| Item | Tool | Version / config |
|---|---|---|
| Runner | Pest | ^5.0 (locked v5.3.1) + `pestphp/pest-plugin-laravel` ^5.0, on PHPUnit 13.4.1 |
| Suites | `phpunit.xml` | `Unit` (`tests/Unit`), `Feature` (`tests/Feature`); `tests/Pest.php` extends `Tests\TestCase` for both |
| Assertions | Pest `expect()`, Laravel HTTP/DB assertions | custom expectation `toBeOne`; helpers `criarTokenApi()`, `definirCredenciaisPadrao()` |
| Mocks | Mockery 1.6.15; `$this->mock()`; `Queue::fake`, `Http::fake`, `Storage::fake` | |
| DB isolation | `uses(DatabaseTransactions::class)` per file | `RefreshDatabase` commented out in `tests/Pest.php`; sqlite lines commented in `phpunit.xml` → tests hit the env DB connection |
| Env overrides | `phpunit.xml` | `APP_ENV=testing`, `CACHE_STORE=array`, `QUEUE_CONNECTION=sync`, `SESSION_DRIVER=array`, `MAIL_MAILER=array`, `PULSE_ENABLED=false`, `BCRYPT_ROUNDS=4` |
| Factories | `fakerphp/faker` v1.24.1 | `database/factories/` (8 factories) |
| Coverage | not found | `phpunit.xml` `<source>` includes `app/`; no report config or script |

### Commands

| Purpose | Command |
|---|---|
| Test | `composer test` (`config:clear` + `artisan test`); from host: `docker compose exec -T php php artisan test --compact` |
| Typecheck | `npm run typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit`) |
| Frontend build | `npm run build` (`vite build`) |
| Dev (all-in-one) | `composer dev` (`concurrently`: `artisan serve`, `queue:listen --tries=1`, `pail`, `npm run dev`) |
| Local setup (README) | `docker-compose up -d`; `./composer install`; `./php artisan key:generate`; `./php artisan migrate:fresh --seed` |
| Prod image local | `./build-prod-local.sh [tag]` (default `sim-mni:prod-local`) |
| CI | `.github/workflows/deploy-production.yaml`: push to `main` → curl `COOLIFY_WEBHOOK_URL`; no test/lint/build step |
| PHP lint | none wired; `laravel/pint` v1.32.1 dev dep, no `pint.json`, no script |

### External integrations

| System | Client wiring |
|---|---|
| Tribunal MNI SOAP | PHP `SoapClient` subclass `App\Services\SoapClientMNI` via `App\Services\IntegracaoBase` |
| Comunica PJe REST | Laravel `Http` facade in `App\Services\ComunicacaoPJe\ConsultarProcessoService` |
| AWS S3 | `league/flysystem-aws-s3-v3` 3.35.3, disk `s3` in `config/filesystems.php` |
| PDF | `barryvdh/laravel-dompdf` v3.1.2 + `setasign/fpdi` v2.6.8 (TCPDF-backed `setasign\Fpdi\Tcpdf\Fpdi`); Ghostscript `gs` binary |
| Error tracking | `sentry/sentry-laravel` 4.28.0 |
| Log shipping | `marvinlabs/laravel-discord-logger` v1.4.4 (channel `discord`); `opcodesio/log-viewer` v3.24.2 |
| AI SDK | `laravel/ai` v1.2.0; `config/ai.php` + `agent_conversations` migration untracked; no usage under `app/` |
